newsitem.title: USA: Revco to begin offer for Big B.
newsitem.headline: Revco to begin offer for Big B.

text.p: Revco D.S. Inc said on Monday it was beginning a cash tender offer for the outstanding stock of Big B Inc at $15 a share.
Following completion of the tender, Revco will offer remaining Big B shareholders the same cash price for their shares, it said.
With Big B's approximately 22 million shares on a fully diluted basis, the deal is worth about $330 million, Revco said.
It said it expects the transaction to be accretive to its earnings per share in the first year after the merger.
Revco said it currently owns 1,190,000 shares of Big B common, representing about 5.4 percent of Big B's shares on a fully diluted basis.
Revco said it intends to finance the tender offer through a combination of cash on hand and bank borrowings.

The offer is conditioned on the acquisition of a majority of Big B's shares on a fully diluted basis and the expiration or termination of any applicable waiting period under U.S. antitrust law, Revco said.
The company said the tender offer is set to expire on October 7.
Revco said its $15-a-share offer represents a premium of 53 percent over the $9.81 average closing price of Big B stock for the 90-day period ended September 6.
